pass_7138_eigenspace_transversal_normal_.geometric_statement: Each nonfixed orbit lies on a unique transversal joining the two fixed generator lines; on a nonisotropic transversal the q-1 internal points split into (q-1)/2 C2 pairs t<->-t.

pass_7139_52set_gram_gauge_reduction.scope: This is an exact exhaustive reduction of any hypothetical 52-set to eight finite clique cases. No 48-clique impossibility is claimed.
pass_7139_52set_gram_gauge_reduction.target: 48-clique among 512 row states after fixing four anchors

pass_7140_allq_involution_theorem.theorem: For odd q, a non-scalar projective involutory symplectic similitude with multiplier -1 has two 2D Lagrangian eigenspaces E+ and E-. Its fixed projective locus is two disjoint generator lines. A g-invariant partial ovoid contains at most one point from each fixed line; hence an odd-sized invariant partial ovoid contains exactly one fixed point.

pass_7142_quadratic_character_switching.boundary: The sign flip between q=1 and 3 mod 4 is finite-field quadratic-character algebra, not physical chirality.

pass_7143_rankone_idempotent_bridge.allq_statement: A nonisotropic transversal ([u],[w]) has u.w !=0 and canonically determines E=w u^T/(u.w), a rank-one trace-one idempotent. Conversely every rank-one trace-one idempotent gives one such transversal.
pass_7143_rankone_idempotent_bridge.repo_interface: This is a genuine M2(F_q) bridge to the earlier rank stratification, but not the same object as the full rank-one Fourier sector. At q=2 there are 6 trace-one rank-one idempotents versus 9 nonzero rank-one matrices; the 6 idempotents are rank-one and therefore are not the 6 units.
